title: CutSign single-video analysis payload, version 1
description: What the engine command `analyze` prints (desktop/api.py analyze) and the oldest project shape. The desktop calls it AnalysisProject and turns it into a version 4 project (editor-model.ts migrateProject / applyAnalysis); the Rust exporter calls it LegacyProject and exports it directly. A document is read as version 1 when `version` is absent or 1.

version.description: Optional: early files have no version field. analyze writes 1.

source.description: Absolute path of the analysed video.

reviewedAt.description: The desktop main process resets it to null after a fresh analysis.

analysis.description: Free-form analysis settings snapshot (detectHuman, sample rates). The desktop keeps blackMinCutSeconds as assets[].minCutSeconds (PROPERTY_PANE P2); nothing else reads it.

partial.description: Optional (CREATOR_SELECTS D13). Written by `analyze --audio-only`: regions hold only silence, loud and speech, and the desktop merges them into the asset instead of replacing every segment. Absent on a full analysis.

id.description: Required by the desktop type; neither reader uses it to build segments.

kind.description: keep is included footage, proposed-cut is excluded footage awaiting or after review.

decision.description: The exporter refuses a proposed-cut whose decision is pending, and exports a region when kind or decision is keep. analyze writes decision pending on an included ai region (kind keep), which the exporter does not block; the desktop blocks it through review instead.

included.description: Optional; the desktop derives it from kind and decision when absent.

origin.description: Optional; the desktop derives analysis-keep or ai from kind when absent.

review.description: Optional; the desktop derives it from kind and decision when absent.

audio.description: Optional, creator preset only: the same shape as project segment.audio (v4). Quietest level for silence, peak level for loud; absent for other origins.
